text:
alex: Heads-up — our streaming sessions dashboard is showing ~2x active sessions in us-west vs raw proxy logs for the past 2h. Looks correlated with a recent client ping change. Anyone seen this?

jia: Hmm, saw that spike in the alerts feed too. Do we think the client 'ping' frames are being interpreted as new activity (vs keepalive) by the metrics pipeline?

leo: Quick check: proxy access logs show frequent small requests with header `X-Client-Ping: true` every 15s from mobile clients. Those entries have status 200 and are funneled through the streaming meter.

samira: That would inflate the "active sessions" metric if the pipeline treats any request touching /stream as a unique touch. Current sliding-window logic increments session activity on any request, not just initial connect.

alex: Repro steps I ran: tail proxy logs, grep client-id. Example snippet:```
# proxy log sample
159.1.2.3 - client=cli-123 path=/stream method=GET header=X-Client-Ping:1
159.1.2.3 - client=cli-123 path=/stream method=GET header=X-Client-Ping:1
```
This shows repeated GETs — clients are re-issuing light pings that the proxy treats as independent touches.

jia: Are these actual new HTTP connections or long-lived sockets with repeated keepalive requests? If it's long-lived SSE, the client should send comments (`: ping`) rather than re-GET. Which client library changed?

leo: Mobile webview bumped to sse-client v2.4. It reopens the connection for pings when network flaps. So we get many short-lived opens.

samira: Two problems: 1) Console metric counts active sessions by recent hits, so reconnects look like new sessions; 2) Quota/billing pipeline counts request tokens and may charge for these pings.

alex: Proposed short-term mitigations:
- Update metrics pipeline to dedupe by session-id (if present) for a 1m window
- Treat `X-Client-Ping` requests as heartbeat-only in billing (no token increment)
- Add a telemetry flag to mark canary customers where we enable dedupe
Canary region: us-west-2/eng-canary

jia: Sounds good. Can we instead canonicalize at the proxy: annotate the request `x-redwood-heartbeat: 1` and don't emit to meter topic? That avoids changing downstream pipelines immediately.

leo: Proxy change is small. Patch idea: on header `X-Client-Ping` -> set `x-redwood-heartbeat: 1` and route metric emission to a filtered topic `stream-heartbeat` that is ignored by active-session count. I'll sketch a patch.

samira: We should be careful: sticky routing and quota windows rely on auth token+route. If we drop counting pings entirely, we might mask abuse where clients re-open rapidly to bypass rate-limits. Need a threshold rule: >10 reconnects/min -> mark suspect and surface in console.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy/ingress v2.19.3 -> canary us-west-2 in 10m (patch: heartbeat annotation).

alex: For UX: Console should show both "unique sessions" and "reconnects" — add a small toggle in the sessions dashboard so support can investigate.

jia: Agreed. Action items:
- leo: PR for proxy header canonicalization + filtered metric topic (canary) — due EOD
- samira: update telemetry docs + add alert rule for reconnect storm (>10/min) — due tomorrow
- alex: follow up with mobile team to pause auto-reconnect in sse-client v2.4 rollout

leo: I'll link the PR here when ready.

alex: Thanks — will monitor infra-bot canary. :thumbsup:
